facts.fact: ATDI trained 25 technicians from nine public bodies, including civil identification, migration, tax, social action and registries, on the X-Road data-exchange layer to prepare them to integrate their institutions' systems, with World Bank EDGE support.

MOZ.note: as_of is the first day of the training, 6-9 October 2026; the story does not say the platform is in service.
No education body or system is among the nine institutions named.
